Predicates:
SupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is a supervised learning algorithm.
UnsupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is an unsupervised learning algorithm.
ReinforcementLearning(x) ::: x is a reinforcement learning algorithm.
Trains(x, y) ::: x trains y.
RequiresLabelledData(x) ::: x requires labelled data.
StateOfTheArtModel(y) ::: y is the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
MachineLearning(x) ::: x is a machine learning algorithm.
Question: ::: "Supervised learning is used to train the state-of-the-art text summarization model."

Premises:
∃x (UnsupervisedLearning(x) ∧ ¬RequiresLabelledData(x)) ::: Unsupervised learning doesn't require labelled data.
∃x (MachineLearning(x) ∧ Trains(x, y) ∧ StateOfTheArtModel(y)) ::: The state-of-the-art text summarization model is trained with machine learning algorithms.
¬∃x (ReinforcementLearning(x) ∧ Trains(x, y)) ::: Reinforcement learning is not used to train the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
∃x (MachineLearning(x) ∧ Trains(x, y) ∧ RequiresLabelledData(x)) ::: The machine learning algorithm for training the model requires labelled data.

Conclusion:
Trains(x, y) ∧ StateOfTheArtModel(y) ∧ SupervisedLearning(x) ::: Supervised learning is used to train the model.
